messages:
sam: Heads-up: noticed duplicate charge when streaming client migrates between router groups during canary. Repro in staging.

maria: Can you paste a snippet of the logs and the steps to repro? :thinking:

sam: Minimal repro: open SSE stream, trigger route swap (force service discovery flip), then client reconnects with resume token. We see two billing events. Logs: 
```
2026-03-20T03:42:11Z router-a INFO resume request session=abc123 resume_token=rt-9 processed bill_event=tok_001
2026-03-20T03:42:12Z router-b INFO resume request session=abc123 resume_token=rt-9 processed bill_event=tok_002
```

kevin: Looks like the resume handshake is retried after the route swap but the new router doesn't know previous ack state -> both routers bill. Telemetry spike at 03:42 in us-west.

sam: We already surface `session_id` and `resume_token` from client. Router keeps an ephemeral ack state in-memory. When we fail over, the new router treats resume as new and charges.

maria: Two quick paths: sticky routing for active streams during rollouts (short TTL, e.g., 30s) or add idempotency/dedupe in billing by a resume key.

kevin: Dedupe on billing side is safer correctness-wise but adds storage/lookup cost. Sticky routing reduces churn but widens blast radius for overloaded nodes.

ops-bot: Deploy started: eng-platform/canary/2026-03-20 03:40 UTC :rocket:

sam: Proposal: introduce `stream_instance_id` clients can send. Routers persist seen resume keys for 2 minutes: if resume_key seen and last_seq <= seen_seq, respond 200 without creating a new bill event. Minimal semantic: resume is idempotent for that window.

maria: Pseudocode patch on ingress: 
```
if seen(resume_key):
  return resume_ok  # don't double-bill
else:
  process_resume_and_bill()
  mark_seen(resume_key, seq)
```

kevin: Also add metric `stream.resume.duplicates` and an alert if > 10/min per region. I'll add a dashboard tile and an SLO note.

sam: :thumbsup: I'll prototype in staging and run a controlled replay. Question for product: do we want to surface `stream_instance_id` as part of the public SDK or auto-generate server-side?

maria: We can auto-generate in the SDK for convenience, and accept server-generated ids for older clients. Need a doc blurb in Console about resume semantics. @product to weigh in on exposure and backwards compat. :memo:

deploy-bot: Canary rollout at 20% paused for 5m due to increased error rate in streaming-resume handler.

kevin: FYI we saw three duplicate charges in prod last week — small amounts but noisy and customer-visible. Prioritize before full rollout.

sam: Will open PR with `stream_instance_id` support, router-side in-memory LRU cache for seen resume keys, and tests. Tagging @maria @kevin on the PR.

maria: Please include concurrency/unit test for concurrent resume race (simulate two routers racing).

kevin: I'll own dashboard, alert and the metric naming. Once PR is up I'll add query and panel to console.

sam: Thanks all, starting work now.
